page.content:
Empty seat at the Table reserved for the Grail knight.

How Siege Perilous connects

  • Character: Galahad — Galahad alone may sit in the Siege Perilous.
  • Faction: Round Table — The Siege Perilous is the reserved seat of the Round Table.

What is Siege Perilous?

The Siege Perilous kills any unworthy sitter. Galahad's safe sitting is the sign that the Grail quest has found its champion.

Key threads lead to Galahad and Round Table.
